title: 0.05 unit insulin resolution
symptom: When entering a treatment in xDrip+ for a microbolus of 0.05-0.1 units of insulin, the app allows entry of 0.05 but displays it as 0.1, rounding the second decimal place.
fix: The issue is expected to be fixed by a referenced pull request, and a maintainer asks the user to update to the latest Nightly release (June 28, 2022) to verify the fix.
evidence_quote: The referenced PR will fix it.
